name: browsermcp
description: Automate your Chrome browser with AI through the Browser MCP extension
long_description:
This MCP server lets AI assistants control a Chrome tab: navigate, read accessibility snapshots, click, type, drag, select options, press keys, take screenshots, read console logs and attach local files to file inputs.

**Note:** This requires the Browser MCP Chrome extension. Install it, open the tab you want to automate, click the extension icon and press 'Connect'.

upload_dir.title: Upload directory
upload_dir.description: Only files inside this directory can be attached with browser_upload_file. Leave empty to disable uploads.

extension_id.title: Chrome extension ID
extension_id.description: Only accept connections from this extension (see chrome://extensions). Leave empty to accept any Chrome extension.

ws_port.title: WebSocket port
ws_port.description: Port the extension connects to. Give each Chrome profile its own port to run several servers side by side.

tools.name: browser_go_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page

tools.name: browser_go_forward
tools.description: Go forward to the next page

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for a specified time in seconds

tools.name: browser_get_console_logs
tools.description: Get the console logs from the browser

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page

tools.name: browser_upload_file
tools.description: Attach a local file from the upload directory to an input[type=file]

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the page and return its value
